svg.title: Deep versus shallow: what each route must know about the AI service
svg.desc: Two module shapes. The top edge of each box is its interface, what a caller must know; the area below is what the module hides. Shallow design: each route calls httpx itself, so the interface is wide (URL, timeouts, httpx exception order, 502 versus 503 rules, reply field names and the list-to-text adapter) and the module hides almost nothing. Deep design: each route calls ai.extract_recipe(text) and gets a RecipeCreate or one of two exceptions; timeouts, error mapping, the contract check, the adapter and, from Lecture 9, retries are hidden inside AIClient, so Lecture 9 edits only that box.

g.text: What must each route know about the AI service?
Shallow: each route calls httpx itself
Interface: what every route must know
URL · timeouts · httpx exception order · 502 vs 503 rules
reply field names and defaults · list-to-text adapter
